item.title: Ibiza Boom by Street Origins – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:

Type:

Overview

Energetic, modern, and irresistibly fresh, Ibiza Boom by Street Origins is an aromatic fruity fragrance that blends vibrant citrus, juicy fruits, and warm woods into a scent that feels effortlessly confident and uplifting. The fragrance opens with a refreshing burst of bergamot, pineapple, apple, and blackcurrant, creating a bright and invigorating introduction. As it develops, aromatic lavender and rose geranium add sophistication and balance before settling into a smooth base of ambergris, cedarwood, musk, and patchouli.

Ibiza Boom captures the excitement of endless summer days and unforgettable nights, delivering a fresh yet refined scent that stands out without trying too hard.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Pineapple, Apple, Blackcurrant

Middle: Lavender, Rose Geranium

Base: Ambergris, Cedarwood, Musk, Patchouli

Inspired & Occasion

Ibiza Boom combines fruity freshness with aromatic depth and a clean woody finish, creating a fragrance profile that feels versatile, modern, and highly wearable. The bright opening and smooth musky dry down make it an excellent choice for those who enjoy fresh fragrances with a touch of sophistication.

Perfect for:

  • Daily wear
  • Spring & summer
  • Vacations
  • Beach days
  • Casual outings
  • Date nights
  • Signature scent lovers

Try Before You Commit

Ibiza Boom opens with a juicy blend of pineapple, apple, and blackcurrant wrapped in sparkling bergamot, creating an energetic and refreshing first impression. As the fragrance settles, aromatic lavender and rose geranium add a clean, refined character that keeps the composition balanced and versatile. In the dry down, ambergris, cedarwood, musk, and patchouli create a smooth, masculine trail that lingers beautifully on the skin. If you enjoy fresh fruity fragrances with a modern woody backbone, Ibiza Boom delivers a vibrant and crowd-pleasing scent experience.

Fresh, fruity, and intriguingly layered, Mirage Heritage by Amaran is a modern oriental-floral fragrance that blends exotic fruits, soft florals, and earthy woods into a vibrant, unisex composition. The scent opens with an energetic mix of lemon grass, mango, and ginger, creating a bright tropical-spicy freshness that feels lively and slightly exotic.

As it develops, the heart introduces rose, turmeric, and iris, adding a floral-spicy complexity that softens the fruitiness while giving the fragrance a warm, slightly golden character. In the dry down, patchouli, moss, musk, and cedar create an earthy woody base that grounds the composition with depth, warmth, and subtle sensuality.

Mirage Heritage balances juicy fruit, soft florals, and earthy woods, resulting in a fragrance that feels both modern and slightly mysterious with a smooth oriental twist.

Fragrance Notes

Top Notes: Lemongrass, Mango, Ginger
Middle Notes: Rose, Turmeric, Iris
Base Notes: Patchouli, Moss, Musk, Cedar

Inspiration & Best Occasions

Mirage Heritage is best suited for year-round wear, with a natural fit for spring and autumn when its balance of freshness and warmth performs best. Its fruity-spicy opening and earthy woody base make it versatile for daytime wear, casual outings, and evening settings where you want something noticeable but not overpowering.

Positioned in the “oriental fruity-woody floral” category, it leans into a slightly exotic profile thanks to mango and turmeric, giving it a more distinctive twist compared to typical fresh-fruity fragrances.

Try Before You Buy

The fragrance opens with a bright burst of mango, lemongrass, and ginger that feels juicy, fresh, and slightly spicy. Within 15–20 minutes, rose, iris, and turmeric begin to emerge, adding a smooth floral warmth with a subtle earthy spice. As it dries down, musk, cedar, patchouli, and moss create a grounded woody finish that lingers softly on the skin with a clean but textured trail.

Mirage Heritage is worth sampling first if you enjoy fruity-floral scents with an unusual spicy-earthy twist, as its mango–turmeric combination can feel quite distinctive depending on skin chemistry.

Sweet, creamy, and deliciously comforting, Strawberry Pound Cake by Paris Corner is a floral fruity gourmand fragrance for women that captures the cozy feeling of a freshly baked strawberry dessert. Released in 2025, the fragrance blends juicy berries, creamy milk accords, soft florals, and warm vanilla into a scent profile that feels playful, sugary, and irresistibly edible.

The fragrance opens with a mouthwatering combination of strawberry, lemon, and coffee, creating a bright fruity sweetness with a slightly rich gourmand twist. As it develops, orange blossom, violet, and cashmere musk add a soft floral-powdery texture that smooths out the sweetness while keeping the scent airy and feminine. In the dry down, vanilla, milk, and musk create a creamy dessert-like finish that feels warm, fluffy, and comforting.

Strawberry Pound Cake balances fruity sweetness and creamy gourmand warmth beautifully, delivering a fragrance that feels cozy, playful, and highly addictive.

Fragrance Notes

Top Notes: Strawberry, Lemon, Coffee
Middle Notes: Cashmere Musk, Orange Blossom, Violet
Base Notes: Vanilla, Milk, Musk

Inspiration & Best Occasions

Strawberry Pound Cake is ideal for fall, winter, cozy evenings, casual outings, and anyone who enjoys sweet bakery-inspired fragrances. Its creamy strawberry gourmand profile makes it perfect for relaxed settings, café dates, layering combinations, and situations where you want a scent that feels warm, sugary, and comforting.

Positioned in the “floral fruity gourmand” category, the fragrance has gained attention among gourmand lovers for its creamy strawberry dessert character and soft musky dry down. Fragrantica users frequently describe it as fluffy, jammy, creamy, and dessert-like, while others compare parts of the scent profile to strawberry frosting, berry pound cake, and café-style sweetness.

Try Before You Buy

Strawberry Pound Cake opens with an immediate burst of sweet strawberry and bright lemon, while the coffee note adds richness underneath the fruity sweetness. Within the first 15–20 minutes, violet, orange blossom, and cashmere musk begin to soften the fragrance, creating a creamy and slightly powdery texture. As it dries down, vanilla, milk, and musk become more dominant, leaving behind a warm dessert-like trail that feels smooth, cozy, and comforting on the skin.

Community opinions on Fragrantica and Reddit are mixed, with some users loving its creamy strawberry pound cake vibe while others find the strawberry accord more tart or synthetic. Many reviewers recommend sampling first before committing to a full bottle.
